test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statement is NOT correct regarding the prokaryotic cell?

options.text: They have only very small ribosomes as organelles
Membrane bound cell organelles are present
Their chromosomes are composed of only nucleic acid.
Their size is generally in the range of 1-10 μm

solution:
The correct answer is __**Membrane-bound cell organelles are present**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement 2 is incorrect **because** one of the primary distinguishing characteristics of prokaryotic cells is the absence of membrane-bound organelles.**
 
• Unlike eukaryotic cells,** prokaryotic cells do not contain a nucleus or other organelles (like mitochondria, endoplasmic reticulum, or Golgi apparatus) that are enclosed within membranes.**
